name: OpenAI math proofs, explained (unofficial)
indexBlurb: the tangentproofs/openai explainer index, an independent fan index

page.desc: Unofficial, AI-assisted plain-English explainers of Lean proofs published in OpenAI's openai/math repository.
page.taglineHtml: Lean 4 proofs from openai/math, read back into plain English: the statement, the definitions it needs, a proof map, and an honest account of what was checked.
page.notesHtml:
Not official documentation. This site is an independent, unofficial, AI-assisted explainer. It is not written, reviewed, endorsed or maintained by OpenAI or by anyone connected with openai/math, Prove2Me, or the mathematicians cited in the papers. The explanations may contain mistakes. The Lean source and the papers are the ground truth; each explainer pins the exact upstream commit it describes and links every claim back to it.

Quoted Lean source remains © OpenAI under the Apache License 2.0. The explainer code in this repository is MIT-licensed.
